nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Mathematical Literacy
nodes.description: Mathematical Literacy — Grade 12 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Investigation and controlled test

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Financial documents, taxation, tariff systems, income and expenditure, cost and selling price, break-even analysis

nodes.title: Financial documents
nodes.description: Tax documents (tax rate tables, IRP5, employee income tax); loan documents (bank statements, loan institutions)

nodes.title: Taxation
nodes.description: Personal income tax, taxable and non-taxable income, rebates, UIF (maximum amount), VAT (15%)

nodes.title: Tariff systems
nodes.description: Compare 2 or more tariff systems: electricity, telephone, municipal, bank, transport tariffs; tables, graphs, formulae

nodes.title: Income, expenditure, profit and loss
nodes.description: Income, expenditures, profit, loss for large organisations: comparison over two years, budgets (projected vs actual)

nodes.title: Cost price and selling price
nodes.description: Cost of producing/manufacturing, appropriate selling price, percentage profit

nodes.title: Break-even analysis
nodes.description: Determine break-even values from formulae and graphs

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Developing questions, collecting data, classifying and organising, summarising, representing, interpreting and analysing data

nodes.title: Developing questions and collecting data
nodes.description: Developing questions around national and global issues; collecting data by developing and using instruments

nodes.title: Classifying and organising data
nodes.description: Sort numerical and categorical data using categories, class intervals, tallies, and frequency tables

nodes.title: Summarising data
nodes.description: Quartiles, inter-quartile range; calculate and analyse measures of central tendency and spread; percentiles

nodes.title: Representing, interpreting and analysing data
nodes.description: Pie charts, histograms/bar graphs, line and broken line graphs, scatter plots, box and whisker plots

nodes.title: Probability
nodes.description: Simple events and compound events, relative frequency and theoretical probability, tree diagrams and two-way tables

nodes.title: Simple events
nodes.description: Dice, coin, lotteries, gambling, insurance risk assessment; relative frequency and theoretical probability

nodes.title: Compound events
nodes.description: Tree diagrams and two-way tables

nodes.title: Finance (continued)
nodes.description: Interest and banking, inflation, exchange rates

nodes.title: Interest and banking
nodes.description: Hire purchase, residual, balloon; loans; interest rate, interest, repayment; investments, insurance plans (interest, interest rate, charges, monthly payment)

nodes.title: Inflation
nodes.description: Buying power over time, prices of items over time, interpret and analyse inflation graphs

nodes.title: Exchange rates
nodes.description: Currency relationships and buying power across different currencies

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment and mid-year examinations

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Conversions, perimeter and area, volume and surface area

nodes.title: Conversions
nodes.description: Conversion factors and tables, metric to imperial, Celsius to Fahrenheit; time (timetables, transport, production, tide)

nodes.title: Perimeter and area
nodes.description: Length, distance, time, perimeter and area with cost calculations applied

nodes.title: Volume and surface area
nodes.description: Surface area, volume, rate (speed, costing), mass/weight, BMI (formula, interpreting charts)

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Scale, maps with grid references, compass directions and slope

nodes.title: Scale
nodes.description: Ratio/bar scale; determine actual lengths/distances; determine scale for drawings/models

nodes.title: Maps
nodes.description: Grid reference, compass directions, slope on map

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 1 and Term 2 content in preparation for mid-year examinations

nodes.title: Internal Examinations
nodes.description: Mid-year internal examinations: Paper 1 (100 marks, 2 hours) and Paper 2 (100 marks, 2 hours)

nodes.description: 100 marks, 2 hours

nodes.description: 100 marks, 2 hours

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Controlled test and preparatory examination

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Plans, models, solving packaging problems and 3D scale models

nodes.title: Plans
nodes.description: Diagrams (assembly instructions); plans (symbols/notation, terminology, actual dimensions using scale, determine suitable scale, draw 2D floor and elevation plans)

nodes.title: Models
nodes.description: Solving packaging problems, 3D scale models, 2D pictures (item arrangement, estimate material quantities)

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of content in preparation for preparatory examinations

nodes.description: Revision of all Finance topics: financial documents, taxation, tariff systems, income/expenditure, cost price, break-even, interest, inflation, exchange rates

nodes.title: Data Handling revision
nodes.description: Revision of all Data Handling topics: collecting, organising, summarising and representing data

nodes.title: Measurement revision

nodes.description: Revision of all Maps, Plans and Other Representations topics: scale, maps, plans and models
